about:
Fisher Hawaii operates from Honolulu, Hawaii, where it was founded in the 1920s as the first office product warehouse in the United States. The company remains locally owned and operated, serving the islands through three locations on Oahu.

The business functions as a full-service retail and commercial office products warehouse, stocking more than 50,000 items across its facilities. Its flagship Mapunapuna warehouse spans over 20,000 square feet, the Kaka'ako location covers 17,000 square feet with 60-plus parking stalls, and a downtown Honolulu store provides additional retail access.

Customers include office managers, teachers, small business owners, artists, students, and educators. The company supplies office and home office furnishings, arts and crafts materials, education and school supplies, and general office products to both commercial and retail buyers.

Fisher Hawaii attributes its longevity to a focus on "serving people" and a commitment to "Bringing You More," emphasizing wide selection and low warehouse prices.
